marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Researching and writting a dissertationfor business students

"Success in your dissertation is crucial to your overall success in your master's qualification. Taking a step by step approach this book guides you through choosing, planning, researching and writing your dissertation. You will be encouraged to develop relevant skills and each step is illustrated by an example of what to do (and sometimes of what not to do). Crucially, the assessment criteria are explained so that your work is focused aroundthe relevant academic objectives. Acknowledging that project work is often not sequential, but demands consideration of several stages at once, it advise how to juggle these challenges."--BOOK JACKET
